# OSS traj-session/1 fixtures (Cherry Studio / Claude Desktop / OpenCraw)

These are **synthetic** `traj-session/1` documents written for reader tests; they
are shaped like the normalized OSS captures in `samples/batch2/oss*` but contain
no private data. They do **not** add real coverage — they only exercise the
reader/export-only path for labels whose native local store schema is not public
(Cherry Studio, Claude Desktop) or whose label is an alias candidate (OpenCraw).
